name: pg_inherit_need_do_commandcounterincrement
goal:
A single ALTER TABLE containing multiple ADD COLUMN actions can fail in a diamond-shaped inheritance hierarchy when a later action needs to see catalog changes made by an earlier one.

Create a table inheriting the same ancestor through two paths, then run a command such as `ALTER TABLE child ADD COLUMN i int, ADD COLUMN j bigint DEFAULT 1`. The command must succeed atomically, and catalog inspection of every descendant must show both columns with the correct inheritance and default metadata. Single-action ALTER TABLE and non-diamond inheritance must remain unchanged.
